title: SmolLM2-135M fine-tuned (8k rows)
description: SmolLM2-135M-Instruct fully fine-tuned for one epoch on 8k rows of v007 (grammar, paraphrases, realistic, hard and formats rows). Compares to the same model with prompting only (exp-006).
notes: Full fine-tune, 8000 rows, 1 epoch(s), loss on output tokens only.
